question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Carolina opened a savings account to save __money for later.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **for a rainy day**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**For a rainy day**" is an idiomatic expression that means saving money for unexpected future expenses or emergencies. (अप्रत्याशित भविष्य के खर्चों या आपात्कालीन स्थितियों के लिए धन की बचत करना)

 
 
• **For example-** *She always set aside money for a rainy day, just in case something unexpected happened.*
 
 
 
• "**Rainy day**" here symbolizes difficult times or unexpected situations.
 
• Just as rain can come unexpectedly and disrupt plans, financial emergencies can also arise suddenly.
 
• Saving money "**for a rainy day**" means putting money aside to be prepared for these unforeseen events.
 
• The use of this expression in the sentence implies that Carolina is being financially responsible and preparing for the future.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**for a cold day**" does not make sense in the context of the sentence as it does not imply any future expenses or emergencies.
 
• "**for a sunny day**" also does not make sense in the context of the sentence as it does not imply any future expenses or emergencies.
 
• "**for a hot day**" does not make sense in the context of the sentence as it does not imply any future expenses or emergencies.
